QuestInfo.name: [Eluna Express] Quiet Reflection
QuestInfo.0: Find Eremos and see where the next stage of your training will take place.
QuestInfo.1: The next stage of your training will take place in Mu Lung Garden, but Eremos still isn't himself. Anyone could see he's upset. He says the garden is a quiet place to train your mind and body, but you think Eremos would benefit from a trip himself. Travel to Mu Lung Garden, and defeat 1,000 monsters.
QuestInfo.2: You've completed the last stage of your training in Mu Lung Garden.
